title: [WIP] Configure pnpm merge driver for pnpm-lock.yaml
body:
## Configure pnpm-lock.yaml merge driver

This PR configures a custom Git merge driver for `pnpm-lock.yaml` to automatically resolve merge conflicts by regenerating the lockfile using `pnpm install`.

**Changes:**
- [x] Create `.gitattributes` file to specify merge driver for `pnpm-lock.yaml`
- [x] Document the git configuration commands in CONTRIBUTING.md
- [x] Verify the setup works correctly

**Implementation Details:**
1. Created `.gitattributes` with the line: `pnpm-lock.yaml merge=pnpm-merge`
2. Added instructions in CONTRIBUTING.md for developers to run:
   - `git config merge.pnpm-merge.name "pnpm-lock.yaml merge driver"`
   - `git config merge.pnpm-merge.driver "pnpm install"`
3. Verified the configuration works using `git check-attr` and `git config --get`

**How it works:**
When a merge conflict occurs in `pnpm-lock.yaml`, instead of showing conflict markers, Git will run `pnpm install` which regenerates the lockfile based on the merged `package.json` files. This eliminates the need for manual conflict resolution in the lockfile.
